body.approach: Add a Pareto cost check (or baseline Ir/ns ceiling) alongside beats_linear in judge.py and surface baseline cost in propose.py prompts.
body.diff:
--- a/runner/proposals/judge.py
+++ b/runner/proposals/judge.py
@@ -52,4 +52,5 @@
     v["valid"] = mf >= 3 * sf and mf > 0
     if lin:
         ml, sl = paired(c["items"], lin["items"])
-        v.update(over_linear=ml, over_linear_se=sl, beats_linear=v["valid"] and ml > 2 * sl)
+        cost_ok = c.get("ir_per_item") is not None and lin.get("ir_per_item") is not None and c["ir_per_item"] <= lin["ir_per_item"]
+        v.update(over_linear=ml, over_linear_se=sl, beats_linear=v["valid"] and ml > 2 * sl, beats_pareto=v["valid"] and ml > 2 * sl and cost_ok)
body.risk: Existing leaderboard consumers expecting only beats_linear may ignore beats_pareto unless PLAN.md is updated.
alternatives: Use a weighted accuracy-vs-log(Ir) score instead of hard ceiling.
Filter proposals by Ir/item <= mlp16 before ranking.

body.approach: Reserve worst-case max_tokens/neurons per call (or add a safety buffer) in headroom() rather than relying on average EST_NEURONS.
body.risk: Tighter reservations may reject valid jobs earlier in the day.
alternatives: Reconcile actual vs pending immediately after each job and pause when actual >= 95% of cap.

body.approach: Move QUEUE, RENDER, QUEUE_MD, and BRANCH to environment overrides with neutral defaults (e.g., queue/queue.json on worker-queue).
body.risk: Requires migrating the active queue file on pilot/lgn-20261115 once.
alternatives: Pass --queue and --branch as required CLI arguments from worker.yml.

body.approach: Wrap valgrind in runner/limits.c in confine mode and enforce a disk quota or tmpfs size limit on /w.
body.risk: Valgrind memory overhead may require a higher --as limit than bare infer.c.
alternatives: Drop confine mode on unsupported kernels and require bwrap --size everywhere.

body.approach: Replace the denylist + SECCOMP_RET_ALLOW tail with an explicit allowlist of minimal syscalls needed by infer.c and train.py.
body.risk: Different libc/glibc versions on CI runners may use slightly different syscalls (e.g. faccessat2, rseq).
alternatives: Keep denylist for train.py (Python/NumPy) and use strict allowlist only for infer.c.

body.approach: Check semantic invariants (guarantee words preserved, correct numeric cap 400 present, target item IDs matched) instead of exact full-line equality.
body.risk: Looser checks might pass awkward phrasing.
alternatives: Keep canary3 strictly as a regression fixture and add separate randomized edit tests.

body.approach: Freeze the top Pareto P5 candidates, pre-register a held-out test plan in ledger/inbox/, and score them once on test.
body.risk: Reveals whether P5's 0.9864 optdigits dev gain generalizes out-of-sample.
alternatives: Cap autonomous P5 runs per task until a test-set checkpoint is recorded.

body.approach: Clarify in README.md why mlp16 optdigits dev is 0.980 in one table and 0.977 in the P5 comparison (or update both to the same run).
alternatives: Link both numbers directly to their runner/results/ run IDs.
